skill.Name: A2Raine_Toncihana_StormCalling
skill.Description: The current answers you. You have four innate abilities: Thunder Lord's Decree, Thunder-Fire, Thunder Step and Lightning Snake.

power.Name: A2Raine_Toncihana_ThunderLordDecree
power.Description: Toggle. While on, every melee attack carries extra electric damage and may paralyze what it strikes. Damage and paralysis chance grow with your character level.

power.Name: A2Raine_Toncihana_ThunderFire
power.Description: Choose an adjacent square, then type how much stored charge to burn, to instantly heat one object there. There is no cap beyond the charge you actually hold. 100 charge buys 5 degrees.

power.Name: A2Raine_Toncihana_ThunderStep
power.Description: Spend a fifth of your maximum charge to strike any square you can see and then trade places with whatever stands there. Cooldown 30 rounds.

power.Name: A2Raine_Toncihana_LightningSnake
power.Description: Spend 1000 charge to loose serpents of electricity into the adjacent square in a chosen direction. Their number and damage grow with your character level, and the extras leap onward to nearby targets.

power.Name: A2Raine_Toncihana_ThunderBreath
power.Description: Exhale a fan of current five squares long and sixty degrees wide. Costs a fifth of your maximum charge and deals 1d4 electric damage per 500 charge spent, to everything the fan touches. The current does not arc onward.
